# Implementation Plan: Extract ralph-overview plugin (Plan 12)

*Generated by `/plan-with-ralph --improve` on 2026-05-21. Improved from `plans/ralph-pipeline-12-package-as-plugin.md` using 4 parallel research agents. Ready for `/implement-with-ralph --from-plan D:/harness-efforts/codexu/.ralph/jobs/ralph-pipeline-12-package-as-plugin/plan.md`.*

## Overview

Extract codexu's "overview" tooling (sync scripts, watcher, MCP server, React viewer, three skills, config + JSON schema) into a NEW reusable plugin at `D:\ai-developer-toolkit\plugins\ralph-overview\`. Then migrate codexu to consume the installed plugin instead of carrying the implementation in-tree.

The work spans TWO repos and ships as TWO commits in TWO repos:

1. **Plugin source tree** — new plugin at `D:\ai-developer-toolkit\plugins\ralph-overview\` (alongside `crews`, `ralph`, `seval`). Branch `add-ralph-overview-plugin` in the toolkit repo. Plain `git checkout -b` — NOT a Ralph-orchestrated worktree.
2. **Codexu consumer migration** — `/implement-with-ralph --from-plan` creates the worktree at `D:\harness-efforts\codexu\.ralph\jobs\ralph-pipeline-12-package-as-plugin\worktree\` on branch `ralph-pipeline-12-package-as-plugin`. Removes the extracted files, registers the installed plugin's MCP server in `.claude/settings.json`, updates `package.json` script wrappers, updates `AGENTS.md`.

**Landing order is strict:** plugin PR merges to `ai-developer-toolkit/main` FIRST, then codexu PR (which depends on the plugin being installable from main).

**Position in DAG:** depends on all data plans (01, 05) + the MCP server (09, 11). Recommend shipping after 01–11 are all stable in codexu — extract from a working system.

## Research Findings

### Codebase Context

- **codexu** (`D:\harness-efforts\codexu`): pnpm@10.11.0 monorepo. `scripts/lib/` contains the full extraction surface; `tools/overview-mcp` and `tools/overview-viewer` are workspace packages; `.claude/skills/{work-on,triage,blocker-report}` are repo-local skills.
- **ai-developer-toolkit** (`D:\ai-developer-toolkit`): sibling plugin host. Plugin marketplace indexes at `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json`, `.github/plugin/marketplace.json`, and `.agents/plugins/marketplace.json`. There is no root `package.json` or `pnpm-workspace.yaml`; MCP plugins are standalone plugin directories. Existing MCP plugins (`devui`, `cli-manager`, `seval`) use plugin-root launchers (`launch.cjs` or `launch.cmd`/`launch.ps1`) that build/download/cache runtime output on first launch instead of relying on a toolkit workspace build. Existing plugins (`crews`, `ralph`, `seval`) follow a canonical layout — see "Canonical plugin shape" below.
- **scripts/lib/ size:** ~8,790 lines across 25 non-test `.mjs` modules + 24 `.d.mts` declarations + 22 `.test.mjs` files as currently enumerated. Do not rely on a hardcoded count during implementation — enumerate `scripts/lib/` at execution time and copy/remove the exact pre-migration set.

### Technical Constraints

**3 critical blocking unknowns identified by Phase-2 architectural review, all resolved in this plan:**

1. **MCP import-path strategy.** Today files directly under `tools/overview-mcp/src/` import `../../../scripts/lib/...`; files nested under `tools/overview-mcp/src/tools/` import `../../../../scripts/lib/...`. **Decision: Option A — plugin-local relative imports.** Plugin layout preserves the same `tools/overview-mcp/src/` nesting depth relative to `scripts/lib/`, so preserve each file's existing import depth when copying MCP files.
2. **Plugin CLI/build/runtime invocation.** Original plan said "wrapper scripts call `ralph-overview dev`" and verified with `pnpm --filter`, but ai-developer-toolkit has no root workspace. **Decision: ship a plugin-root `launch.cjs` for MCP startup plus a `bin/ralph-overview.mjs` Node dispatcher** with subcommands `sync`, `watch`, `dev`, `build`, `mcp`, `install-server`, `cli`, each accepting `--repo <consumerRoot>` (defaults to cwd's git root). The launcher stages/builds `tools/overview-mcp` into a versioned cache on first launch (or uses committed/prebuilt `dist/` if that path is chosen during implementation) and then spawns the MCP server. The dispatcher resolves plugin root from `CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT` or its own file path and delegates to plugin-local scripts via absolute paths; do not rely on a consumer PATH entry or a toolkit-level workspace.
3. **Plugin manifest shape.** Original plan's top-level `plugin.json` with `skills`, `mcpServers`, `consumerSetup` fields **does not match the canonical ai-developer-toolkit shape**. Canonical shape (from `crews`, `ralph`, `seval`): `.claude-plugin/plugin.json` with only `{ name, description, version, author, keywords }`; MCP servers registered via a **separate** `.mcp.json` at plugin root using `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}` and invoking the plugin-root launcher; skills auto-discovered from `skills/<name>/SKILL.md`; marketplace registration via matching entries in all three toolkit marketplace indexes. See "Canonical plugin shape" below.

**Additional constraints surfaced by research:**

- **`tools/overview-viewer/vite.config.ts`** hardcodes consumer-relative paths: `../../plans`, `../../scripts/lib/watch-ralph-state.mjs`, `outDir: '../../plans'`, `server.fs.allow`. Must become config-driven via `loadConfig({ repoRoot })`.
- **MCP operational tools** (`dev-server-start.ts`, `build.ts`, `sync-now.ts`) spawn `pnpm overview`, `pnpm overview:build`, `node scripts/sync-ralph-state.mjs` in the consumer repo. Post-extraction they must invoke the plugin CLI by absolute plugin path (`node ${pluginRoot}/bin/ralph-overview.mjs dev --repo <repoRoot>` etc.).
- **`install-server.ts`** hardcodes server name `codexu-overview` and points at `repoRoot/tools/overview-mcp/dist/index.js`. Must register from plugin path under generic name `ralph-overview`, mirroring `.mcp.json`: `command: "node"`, `args: ["${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/launch.cjs"]`.
- **`scripts/lib/default-config.mjs`** exports symbol `codexuDefaultConfig`. Rename to generic `defaultOverviewConfig`. Update all importers in plugin tree.
- **`.ralph/overview-config.schema.json`** title/id are codexu-specific. Plugin template copy must scrub.
- **UI codexu-specific copy/state** beyond Toolbar (App.tsx title `codexu — plan overview`, `StaticSections.tsx`, `TaskCommand.tsx`, `PhaseTree.tsx`, `TopLevelSurfaces.tsx`, `CommandList.tsx`, `data/copyPreambles.ts` copy-command templates, `hooks/useDensity.ts`, `hooks/usePersistentExpanded.ts`, `utils/whatsNew.ts`). Generalize via one typed consumer-data surface, `OverviewData.ui?: { title?: string, labels?: { workstream?: Record<string, string>, scope?: Record<string, string> }, copyPreambles?: Record<string, string> }`, or generic plugin defaults, including persistent localStorage key prefixes and what's-new state labels.
- **`tools/overview-viewer/src/utils/filters.ts`** already reads `data.workstream`, `data.sizeBucket`, `data.cadence`, `parseTaskScope(data.tasks[].scope)` — the Toolbar refactor target is clearer than the original plan suggested. `data.workstream` is an OBJECT keyed by taskId with workstream keys as values (not an array).
- **`.claude/settings.json`** is the active settings file in codexu (NOT `.claude/settings.local.json` as the original plan assumed). Plan's MCP-registration steps target `settings.json`.
- **Root doc to update is `AGENTS.md`, NOT `CLAUDE.md`** — codexu has no root CLAUDE.md. The pointer line that currently reads `scripts/lib/watch-ralph-state.mjs` and `pnpm sync-ralph-state:watch` must be updated.
- **`resolveCrewsRoot()`** intentionally resolves `.crews` relative to git common root for linked worktrees. Preserve this behavior in extraction — do not simplify.
- **Sidecar contract preservation:** viewer executes `overview-data.js` and `overview-ralph-state.js` via `new Function` to populate `window.OVERVIEW_DATA` / `window.OVERVIEW_RALPH_STATE`. Plugin MUST preserve this contract — viewer loader code cannot change shape.
- **Activity reader AGENTS.md rule:** `useActivityEvents.ts` skips malformed final JSONL line silently, warns only for malformed interior lines. Preserve.
- **Watcher/CLI shared lock:** `.ralph/overview-sync.lock` JSON shape + process labels are read by MCP tools via `readLockStatus`. Preserve.

## Approach

### Architecture

- **Two repos, two commits, two branches.** Plugin source lives in `ai-developer-toolkit`; consumer migration in `codexu`.
- **Hard merge ordering:** plugin merges first; codexu PR opens with plugin install command in its README/notes and depends on plugin being installable from `ai-developer-toolkit/main`.
- **Plugin entry-point CLI** (`bin/ralph-overview.mjs`) is the single boundary between consumer and plugin. Consumer never imports plugin modules directly; everything flows through subcommands invoked by absolute plugin path, not a bare PATH binary.
- **MCP server registration** via `.mcp.json` + manual `.claude/settings.json` add in consumer (documented; plugin install hook may automate later). Both point at the plugin-root launcher (`node ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/launch.cjs`) rather than `tools/overview-mcp/dist/index.js` directly.
- **Codexu post-migration** keeps the consumer's content (`plans/overview-data.js`, `.ralph/overview-config.json` + schema, generated artifacts under `plans/`, `tasks/<id>/journal.md`) and root convenience scripts that wrap the plugin CLI.

## Scope

### In Scope

- Plugin source tree creation under `D:\ai-developer-toolkit\plugins\ralph-overview\` with canonical `.claude-plugin/plugin.json` shape + `.mcp.json` + root `launch.cjs` + `bin/ralph-overview.mjs` CLI dispatcher.
- Marketplace registration via `D:\ai-developer-toolkit\.claude-plugin\marketplace.json`, `D:\ai-developer-toolkit\.github\plugin\marketplace.json`, and `D:\ai-developer-toolkit\.agents\plugins\marketplace.json`.
- Codexu consumer migration: file removals + repo-local `bin/ralph-overview.mjs` wrapper + `package.json` script wrappers + `pnpm-workspace.yaml` updates + `.claude/settings.json` MCP entry + `AGENTS.md` doc update.
- Generalization of all codexu-specific seams: Vite config, install-server, MCP operational tools spawn commands, `default-config.mjs` symbol name, schema title/id, UI copy/state in App/StaticSections/TaskCommand/PhaseTree/TopLevelSurfaces/CommandList/copyPreambles/useDensity/usePersistentExpanded/whatsNew/styles.
- `Toolbar.tsx` data-driven workstream + scope chip refactor with new tests.
- Plugin isolation smoke test in throwaway directory.
- Plugin docs (`README`, `installation`, `configuration`, `extending`) + templates (`overview-config.template.json`, `overview-config.schema.json` scrubbed, `overview-data.template.js`).
- Codexu test suite passes post-migration; plugin owns all extracted tests.

### Out of Scope

- Publishing to public npm registry (plugin lives in internal `ai-developer-toolkit`).
- Multi-language / localization.
- Backwards-compatibility shims for codexu's pre-existing script names (the new wrappers preserve names but delegate to plugin — no compatibility code paths).
- Migration tooling for hypothetical future adopters (docs cover the install/config flow; new adopters read `docs/installation.md`).
- Plugin auto-update mechanism (future v1.1).
- Plugin telemetry (overkill for small audience).
- Detached/daemon mode for the dev server (future v1.1).

## Risk Areas

### Critical (blocks shipping)

- **Plugin launch/build model** — ai-developer-toolkit has no root workspace, so `pnpm --filter @ralph/...` and direct `.mcp.json` references to `tools/overview-mcp/dist/index.js` will fail after marketplace install if `dist/`/`node_modules` are absent. Mitigation: mirror `devui`/`cli-manager`/`seval`: `.mcp.json` invokes root `launch.cjs`, launcher builds/caches the MCP server on first launch or uses committed/prebuilt `dist/`, and verification runs plugin-local npm scripts from `plugins/ralph-overview/`.
- **Plugin CLI dispatcher correctness** — if `bin/ralph-overview.mjs` mishandles `--repo` arg propagation, every downstream invocation (Vite, sync, MCP tools) breaks in subtle ways. Mitigation: unit tests for dispatcher + integration test (smoke step 12).
- **MCP import path preservation** — imports in `tools/overview-mcp/src/**` must keep their per-file relative depth after copy: files directly under `src/` use `../../../scripts/lib/`; files under `src/tools/` use `../../../../scripts/lib/`. Flattening them all to one depth breaks nested tool imports. Mitigation: verify both depths are present in the plugin MCP tree and the MCP build passes.
- **Vite config genericization** — viewer Vite config currently hardcodes 4+ codexu-relative paths. Easy to miss one and produce a viewer that only works in codexu's layout. Mitigation: smoke test 12 explicitly runs viewer from a non-codexu workspace.
- **Plugin merge ordering** — codexu PR cannot land until plugin PR merges. If they merge out of order, codexu's `pnpm install` fails for missing plugin install command. Mitigation: codexu PR description explicitly notes the plugin-PR dependency; reviewers gate accordingly.

### High (causes regressions)

- **Toolbar refactor data shape** — `data.workstream` is an OBJECT keyed by taskId, not an array or a map keyed by workstream name; code that does `Object.keys(data.workstream ?? {})` renders task IDs as chip labels. Correct: `[...new Set(Object.values(data.workstream ?? {}))].sort()`. Mitigation: new tests with non-codexu fixtures verify chip rendering.
- **Watcher Vite plugin re-import** — viewer Vite config imports `watch-ralph-state.mjs` to start the watcher. Post-extraction, this import path must change (and survive). Mitigation: smoke test confirms HMR.
- **Sidecar contract drift** — viewer loads `overview-data.js` and `overview-ralph-state.js` via `new Function`. Plugin must preserve sidecar JSON shape exactly. Mitigation: existing snapshot-schema validation runs in tests.
- **`resolveCrewsRoot()` git-worktree behavior** — preserve git-common-root resolution; do NOT simplify to `path.join(repoRoot, '.crews')`. Mitigation: codexu uses linked worktrees heavily; smoke any worktree-related code path.
- **MCP server name collision** — if codexu still has the old `codexu-overview` entry in `.claude/settings.json` AND the new `ralph-overview` from plugin install, both may try to bind. Mitigation: migration step 15 explicitly removes the old entry.
- **Skills CLI command rewrite** — skills currently call `pnpm sync-ralph-state` and `node scripts/lib/derive-next-command-cli.mjs`. Post-extraction, these paths don't exist in codexu. If skills aren't updated, they break for codexu users. Mitigation: step 7 audits + rewrites; step 12 smoke runs at least `work-on` from the plugin's skill in a test workspace.

### Medium (causes friction)

- **UI copy/state fallbacks** — App title, static sections, command text, top-level surfaces, persistent localStorage keys, and what's-new state need the single typed `OverviewData.ui` surface (`title`, `labels.workstream`, `labels.scope`, `copyPreambles`) or equivalent generic/default patterns. Easy to miss spots, and untyped `data.ui` reads will fail typecheck because the current canonical `OverviewData` has no `ui` field. Mitigation: update `tools/overview-viewer/src/types.ts`, keep `tools/overview-mcp/src/types.ts` re-exporting that canonical type, update `templates/overview-data.template.js` and relevant schema/docs/tests, then run `grep -RIlEi 'codexu|codex' tools/overview-viewer/src` during US-004 and reconcile every non-test source hit, including `TopLevelSurfaces.tsx`, `CommandList.tsx`, `useDensity.ts`, `usePersistentExpanded.ts`, and `utils/whatsNew.ts`.
- **Test placement decision** — plugin owns extracted tests, codexu loses them. If any codexu integration test references the removed test fixtures, codexu CI breaks. Mitigation: grep codexu for references to removed test paths.
- **pnpm-workspace.yaml dangling references** — if any codexu package still depends on `@codexu/overview-mcp` or `@codexu/overview-viewer`, `pnpm install` post-removal fails. Mitigation: pre-check `grep -r "@codexu/overview" packages tools` (cross-checked by researcher — currently NO external refs, but verify at execution).
- **Marketplace index sync** — adding to all three marketplace indexes is required so Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, and repo-local Codex discovery stay aligned. Easy to miss in PR. Mitigation: explicit step 1; verifier checks all three marketplace entries and diffs their normalized fields.
- **Symbol rename ripple** — `codexuDefaultConfig` → `defaultOverviewConfig` rename touches `default-config.mjs` and every importer. Mitigation: grep + rename; tests catch any miss.

### Low

- **Plugin's own CI** — ai-developer-toolkit may have plugin-level CI gates. If `ralph-overview` doesn't conform (e.g., missing `tsconfig.json`), CI may fail. Mitigation: read how sibling plugins (`crews`, `seval`) handle this; mirror.
- **Cross-platform path handling** — plugin runs on Windows + macOS + Linux. Use `path.posix.join` for JSON-emitted paths; `path.join` for filesystem. Codexu already does this.

A. **Plugin manifest valid.** `cat D:/ai-developer-toolkit/plugins/ralph-overview/.claude-plugin/plugin.json` — fields exactly `name|description|version|author|keywords`. `cat .mcp.json` — `mcpServers.ralph-overview` invokes `node ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/launch.cjs` with `type: "stdio"`. Diff normalized marketplace fields to catch divergence: compare `{name, source/path, description, version}` across all three entries; only `.agents/plugins/marketplace.json` may encode source as `source.path`.

Clear the launcher's versioned cache (or use a fresh cache dir), then run an MCP startup smoke through `.mcp.json`/`launch.cjs` so the first-run build/cache path is exercised and `dist/`/`node_modules` are not assumed to exist after marketplace install. Verify both expected MCP script-lib import depths exist: `grep -rE "\.\./\.\./\.\./scripts/lib" tools/overview-mcp/src/*.ts` finds direct-`src/` imports, and `grep -rE "\.\./\.\./\.\./\.\./scripts/lib" tools/overview-mcp/src/tools/*.ts` finds nested tool imports.

- `cat .claude/settings.json | jq '.mcpServers["ralph-overview"]'` returns a record; `.mcpServers["codexu-overview"]` is null
- `grep "watch-ralph-state.mjs\|pnpm sync-ralph-state:watch" AGENTS.md` returns 0 hits
- `git grep -IlEi 'codexu|codex' -- bin package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml AGENTS.md .claude/settings.json plans/overview-data.js .ralph/overview-config.json` has no hits outside preserved codexu data/config, expected wrapper/metadata files, `AGENTS.md`, or a small PR-described allowlist

G. **No dual ownership.** In codexu: `git log --follow --oneline scripts/lib/derive-ralph-stage.mjs` shows the file's history ending with the migration commit's deletion. In ai-developer-toolkit: `git log --follow --oneline plugins/ralph-overview/scripts/lib/derive-ralph-stage.mjs` shows the file's history starting with the plugin PR. Two independent histories.

H. **Plugin parity (optional).** All MCP tools registered by codexu's old MCP server are still registered by the plugin's MCP server. Compare tool lists: `pre-migration ls overview.* tools` vs `post-migration ls overview.* tools`.

## Common mistakes / confusion points

1. **Plugin manifest is `.claude-plugin/plugin.json`, NOT top-level `plugin.json`.** The original Plan 12 used the wrong path.
2. **MCP servers go in a separate `.mcp.json`**, NOT in the `plugin.json`. The format uses `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}` and must invoke the plugin-root launcher (`node ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/launch.cjs`), not `tools/overview-mcp/dist/index.js` directly.
3. **Marketplace registration is required in all three indexes** — add the plugin to `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json`, `.github/plugin/marketplace.json`, and `.agents/plugins/marketplace.json` at toolkit root so all installers/discovery paths see the same plugin/version. Easy to forget.
4. **`AGENTS.md`, not `CLAUDE.md`.** Codexu has no root CLAUDE.md. The doc pointing at sync scripts is AGENTS.md.
5. **`.claude/settings.json`, not `.claude/settings.local.json`.** Codexu uses the non-local variant.
6. **`data.workstream` is an OBJECT keyed by taskId, not an array or a workstream-name map.** Use unique sorted `Object.values(data.workstream ?? {})`, not `Object.keys()`, so chips show workstream keys instead of task IDs.
7. **Plugin CLI MUST accept `--repo`** for every command. Without it, the consumer's repo root can't be passed through to Vite, sync, etc.
8. **Image of installed plugin path is via `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}` or a resolved installed-plugin root.** Hardcoding `D:/ai-developer-toolkit/plugins/ralph-overview` breaks on other machines; relying on a bare `ralph-overview` PATH binary is also invalid unless the installer explicitly links one. Codexu package scripts should call the repo-local `bin/ralph-overview.mjs` shim so plugin path resolution is centralized.
9. **MCP imports preserve per-file depth.** Direct `src/` files use `../../../scripts/lib/`; nested `src/tools/` files use `../../../../scripts/lib/`. The plugin layout preserves the same nesting, so copy these imports as-is.
10. **`codexuDefaultConfig` → `defaultOverviewConfig`** rename ripples to importers. Use grep + rename; rely on tests to catch misses.
11. **Vite config is the most fragile file in the extraction.** Hardcodes `../../plans` in 4+ places. Genericize ALL of them.
12. **UI copy/state beyond Toolbar matters.** Don't forget App.tsx title, StaticSections, TaskCommand, PhaseTree, TopLevelSurfaces, CommandList, copyPreambles, useDensity/usePersistentExpanded localStorage keys, whatsNew, and styles. Run `grep -RIlEi 'codexu|codex' tools/overview-viewer/src` before ending US-004.
13. **Do not use stale hardcoded script counts** — US-002 must `ls scripts/lib/` at execution time and include whatever files are actually there. Current codexu has 25 non-test `.mjs`, 24 `.d.mts`, and 22 `.test.mjs` files in `scripts/lib/`.
14. **Plugin owns the tests** — codexu loses ~76 test files. Verify no codexu integration test imports them after migration.
15. **Plugin merge ordering is strict.** Codexu PR fails CI if plugin not on toolkit/main. Don't open codexu PR until plugin merged.
16. **`resolveCrewsRoot()` does git-common-root** — don't simplify to `path.join(repoRoot, '.crews')`. Linked worktrees in codexu depend on the current behavior.
